intended_object: The graph parameterization v ↦ v + h(v) of the local stable set of the hyperbolic equilibrium 0 of x' = Ax + N(x). Its domain is the closed ρ-ball in the stable spectral subspace range P, and its target is the set of points whose forward solution stays in the r-ball and whose stable projection has norm ≤ ρ. The inverse is the stable projection P. This comes from the docstring, the module documentation and the companion simp lemmas.
